reason: A real photograph of a compact robot gearbox or exposed motor-to-wheel transmission would ground the abstract tooth-count diagrams in recognizable hardware and help students connect calculated ratios with physical packaging, shafts, bearings, and wheel placement. The existing diagrams are sufficient for the mathematics, so a short hardware photo is more valuable than an additional conceptual video.
